question: What plans, clearances, and professional seals are mandatory to apply for a Building Permit at OCBO?
answer:
To apply for a Building Permit at OCBO, the following plans, clearances, and professional seals are mandatory:

1. Approved plan of Building Permit [S3, S5]
   - Owner/Applicant: 1 original

2. If the project has been undertaken/assigned to a professional other than the professional-in-charge upon application of building permit, a signed and duly notarized waiver from the previous professional-in-charge [S3]
   - Waiving Party: 1 original

3. Structure Images with CAAP clearance (submit structural survey for the actual building height) signed and sealed by a duly licensed Geodetic Engineer [S3]
   - CAAP & Hired Geodetic Engineer

Citation: [S3] OCBD Pages from CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-2.pdf | printed page 501 | chunk DEV120-OCBO-PDF0013-C004

ground_truth: To secure a Building Permit under PD 1096, applicants must submit: 1) Notarized Application Letter; 2) Accomplished Unified Building Permit Form (5 copies); 3) Complete sets of Architectural, Civil/Structural, Sanitary/Plumbing, Electrical, and Mechanical Permit forms and plans (5 sets each), all duly signed and sealed by licensed professionals (Architect, Civil Engineer, Sanitary Engineer/Master Plumber, Professional Electrical Engineer, Professional Mechanical Engineer); 4) Certified true copies of Land Title (LRA), Tax Declaration, and Current Real Property Tax Receipt; 5) CPDO Zoning Locational Clearance; and 6) BFP Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance (FSEC).
